Deal: Scoot O/W Vienna for Christmas Markets: Mid-Nov PER $567, MEL $587, SYD $602; Home 6 Dec PER $705, MEL $727, SYD $734 @ Skyspy

[dosada] Who's talking about the picture or Venice?
[Whoozen] I'll be in europe during December and just looking for the cheapest way to get back to australia after december 20, any suggestions? Really dont mind leaving from any airport
[driva] Set uo a price alert on google flight. i took Scoot syd to Vienna. Scootbiz for 900 on sale.
[mulimulix] Vienna christmas markets were great last year but I still preferred the charm of the German ones. Basically the less touristy but still large cities like Dresden were my favourite for the markets.
[ash2000] As pretty as the European Christmas markets are, at the end of the day they are just selling Temu tat that has been unboxed and arranged creatively on festively decorated trestle table and sold at astronomical markup .
[dosada] That's absolutely not true. There's plenty of food and drink items, hand made stuff and so on. Maybe there's some small part of temu crap but definitely not the majority. At least in Vienna
[bluepop] Make sure they refund your Glühwein cup at the market. They tried it on with us.
